content.text:
**Defining the Template**

I've been working on how to define the initial template shape. My current approach involves identifying the color with the maximum cell count, with a unique tie-breaking policy. This color will then represent the template in the corner of the grid, which will be the initial shape to use to complete partial translated copies, which will then be erased.


**Refining the Template Logic**

I've been drilling down on template projection. The strategy is now to group by color, then select the color with the maximum cell count as the template. It appears to form a diamond / hollow diamond / rotated square of size 5x5 centered at a specific location, based on my tests. I am seeing how the specific geometry is crucial, and am planning to use the full diamond as the source for the template.
